<!--
  Beginner? Start here.

  A feature request is an idea for something new or better. You don't need a
  complete design -- just describe the problem you're trying to solve. We'll
  work through the details together. No idea is too small.
-->

## What problem does this solve

[Describe the problem from a user's perspective. Who needs this and why?]

## OSS-first search

Before proposing a new feature, search for existing implementations.

- What did you search for? ___
- What did you find? ___
- Why didn't it fit? ___
- `[CONFIGURE: link to oss-first-search.md checklist]`

## Gold standard check

Does a human-crafted reference implementation exist for this pattern?

- [ ] Yes (link: ___)
- [ ] No (one must be created first before AI extends it)

## Proposed solution

[Describe what you'd like to happen.]

## This feature would remove or simplify...

[What existing complexity does this replace, reduce, or eliminate? If it only
adds complexity, explain why the addition is justified.]

## Scope containment

Is this one function/component or a whole feature?

- [ ] Single function/component
- [ ] Multi-component (split into smaller issues first)

## Alternatives considered

[What other approaches did you think about? Why is this one better?]

## Accessibility considerations

- [ ] This feature involves UI changes (needs keyboard + screen reader testing)
- [ ] This feature involves new interactive controls (needs touch target + focus management)
- [ ] This feature is non-UI (no accessibility impact expected)

## Scope guard

- Allowed files: [files that should change]
- Out-of-scope files: [files that should NOT be touched]

## AI usage level

- [ ] **AIL-0**: No AI tools used
- [ ] **AIL-1**: AI-assisted (human wrote the core logic; AI helped with boilerplate, lookups, or suggestions)
- [ ] **AIL-2**: AI-generated (AI produced the primary output; human reviewed and edited)

## Learning objective

`[CONFIGURE: What skill are you practicing or building with this issue? e.g., "learning component design", "first feature proposal", "exploring API patterns". Leave blank if not applicable.]`

## Additional context

[Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other projects, etc.]
